opportunities.name: AA flight status lookup by flight number and date
opportunities.description: On American Airlines' homepage, open the Flight status tab, switch Search by to Flight number, enter a flight number, pick a date, and run Search to read the status.
steps: Click the 'Flight status' tab on the booking widget.
Click the 'Flight number' pill under 'Search by:'.
Click the Flight number input and type the flight number.
Open the Date dropdown and choose the target date (leave default if it matches).

instances.values: Flight number 12345678, date left at default (Friday, April 7); Search clicked at t≈32.
Flight number 6944, date Thursday, April 6 (default), date dropdown inspected before Search at t≈1040.

opportunities.name: Booking lookup by reference number and last name
opportunities.description: Look up an existing reservation or receipt by entering a reference/ticket number and selecting or entering a last name, then submitting the form to view the record.
opportunities.site: aa.com receipts page and amtrak.com My Trip (two different sites, same pattern)
steps: Navigate to the lookup page (AA: Contact American > Receipts and refunds > Tickets and fees; Amtrak: click 'MY TRIP' in the top nav).
Click the reference/ticket number input and type the number.
Click the last-name field (AA) or open the 'Select' dropdown and choose 'Last Name' (Amtrak), then type the last name.

instances.values: AA receipts: ticket number 1234567890123, last name Davis; submitted at t≈74.
Amtrak My Trip: reservation number 123456, selector set to Last Name, last name Smith; submitted at t≈987.

opportunities.name: Amtrak deals by region
opportunities.description: Open Amtrak's Deals & Promotions page and change the 'Display deals in' region dropdown to a chosen region to list matching deals.
steps: Click the 'DEALS' item in the top navigation.
Click the 'Display deals in' dropdown (currently 'All Regions').
Select the desired region from the list.
Read the deals shown for that region.

instances.values: Region set to the third option in the list (label partly obscured in the recording); selection made at t≈117.
Same flow repeated with the same third-option region highlighted; region dropdown opened at t≈1093.
